# [CS076] Request Sent over Plaintext HTTP (go.security.plaintext-http-request)

http.Get is called with a constant http:// URL of a host other than localhost.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-319](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/319.html) |
| **OWASP** | A04:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Data sent over plain HTTP can be read and changed by anyone on the network path: credentials, tokens, and the response the program acts on. The rule matches constant URLs only, so it has no false positives from variables; URLs of localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1] are allowed for local services and tests.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
resp, err := http.Get("http://api.example.com/v1/rates")
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
resp, err := http.Get("https://api.example.com/v1/rates")
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [go.security.plaintext-http-request]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    go.security.plaintext-http-request: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore go.security.plaintext-http-request -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** go.security.plaintext-http-request
```
